questions.text: Which sea is so salty that swimmers float on it with ease?
questions.explanation: The Dead Sea's very high salt content makes it extremely buoyant.
Cairo sits on the banks of the Nile near the start of its delta.
The Thames runs through the heart of London.

questions.text: Mount Everest lies on the border of Nepal and which other country?
questions.explanation: The Nepal-China border runs across Everest's summit.
The Seine runs through Paris past Notre-Dame.

questions.text: Which Alaskan mountain is the highest peak in North America?
questions.explanation: Denali, once called Mount McKinley, rises to about 6,190 metres.

questions.text: Which mountain range forms the traditional boundary between Europe and Asia in Russia?
questions.explanation: The Ural Mountains are the conventional Europe-Asia divide.

questions.text: Which is the highest mountain in Africa?
questions.explanation: Kilimanjaro in Tanzania rises to about 5,895 metres.

questions.text: Into which sea does the Volga River flow?
questions.explanation: The Volga empties into the Caspian Sea.

questions.text: Which strait separates Spain from Morocco at the entrance to the Mediterranean?
questions.explanation: The Strait of Gibraltar is only about 14 km wide at its narrowest.

questions.text: Which river forms much of the border between Texas and Mexico?
questions.explanation: The Rio Grande marks most of the US-Mexico border in Texas.

questions.text: In which ocean is the Mariana Trench, the deepest known part of the seabed?
questions.explanation: The Mariana Trench lies in the western Pacific.

questions.text: Which is the longest river in Europe?
questions.explanation: The Volga is about 3,500 km long.

questions.text: K2, the world's second-highest mountain, lies in which range?
questions.explanation: K2 sits on the Pakistan-China border in the Karakoram.

questions.text: Which strait separates Asia from North America at their closest point?
questions.explanation: The Bering Strait lies between Russia's Chukotka and Alaska, about 85 km wide.

spares.text: Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia?
spares.explanation: The Indian Ocean lies between Africa, Asia and Australia.

spares.text: Victoria Falls lies on which river?
spares.explanation: Victoria Falls is on the Zambezi between Zambia and Zimbabwe.
Baghdad lies on the banks of the Tigris.
